name: @etzhayyim/resource-flow-kotoba
description: kotoba reference implementation of resource-flow (public 2次ソース resource-flow visualization data: emitter registry + flow edges + anomaly records) using @etzhayyim/sdk. Registry on AT PDS (replaces RW). (c) mixed split: the public externally-authored flow data migrates; the anomaly-detection algorithm + sankey-MV aggregation compute stays etzhayyim via consent-capability. Substrate posture per ADR-2605172000 + ADR-0028.
